items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I think with the, the Playhouse I used to work at on, I think it was St. Louis and Bourbon. And me and Bob Ostens, another good musician, Harold.

ctx.x: Was there a place called the Playhouse or the Playboy or something like that around?

Yeah. Yeah, I played the, I think with the, not the Playboy, I think with the, the Playhouse I used to work at on, I think it was St. Louis and Bourbon. And me and Bob Ostens, another good musician, Harold. What does Harold play? Harold played saxophone.
